title: Version the Extended Historical Scoring Baseline Explicitly
body:
## Problem

The new tee/fairway/rough support to 600 yd retains the abbreviated table version identifier. Content SHA distinguishes the values, so numeric scoring remains traceable, but the version label is misleading.

## Acceptance Criteria

After frozen flights finish, assign a full-table version, rerun scoring postprocess and update manifests/receipts while retaining original flight run-start provenance. Confirm numeric API parity and clearly distinguish historical shortened support.

## Validation

Baseline version/digest assertions, independent API/cache parity, and updated scoring manifests after postprocessing all 24 completed CSV bundles.

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
